phases.objective: Keep the repository regression contract aligned with the trusted default-branch generated-artifact command workflow after removal of work-branch push execution and adoption of direct canonical decision publication.

e2e_journeys.actor: trusted repository operator and repository automation
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A newly created trusted pull-request comment or explicit workflow_dispatch command on the default-branch workflow definition
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The dispatcher validates the exact PR head, delegates only to the registered writer, uploads and directly publishes its structured decision, and retains no branch-push or direct contents-write authority.
steps: Accept only issue_comment created events or explicit workflow_dispatch inputs.
Reject work-branch push and pull-request workflow entrypoints.
Require a trusted author association, same-repository PR, governed work branch, exact lowercase SHA, and explicit refresh label.
Checkout publisher code from main with persisted credentials disabled.
Dispatch the registered exact-head writer with typed confirmation.
Publish the exact decision to the associated PR before enforcing the outcome.
assertions: The workflow has no push trigger.
The workflow has actions:write, contents:read, issues:write, and pull-requests:read, with no contents:write.
Publisher code is loaded from main with persist-credentials=false.
The dispatcher performs no git push or direct repository contents mutation.
Protected branches, malformed candidates, untrusted authors, ambiguous PRs, and stale heads fail closed.
The structured report declares consult_job_logs=false and secrets_included=false.
The canonical decision is published directly before enforcement.

phases.objective: Prove one live trusted comment command publishes a canonical dispatcher decision and delegates the exact-head writer.
Exercise stale-head, missing-label, ambiguous-PR, dispatch rejection, and publisher failure paths without Job-log authority.
Observe one non-production generated-artifact refresh through the trusted command path.
The dispatcher rejects protected branches and grants no deployment or Production authority.
